title: Is the Order an Anime Podcast?
author: Is the Order an Anime Podcast?
description: Is the Order an Anime Podcast? Why yes, yes it is. Our name takes inspiration from Gochuumon wa Usagi desu ka? or Is the Order a Rabbit? and on this podcast we look to discuss anime specific topics (though eventually we're bound to run out and find a new format). Every week at 3 PM EST on Saturday you can expect to find this trio of idiots discussing their opinions on a medium we all enjoy considerably.
